notes: Book chapter. The book (1898) has no preface; each chapter is a self-contained piece in spoken-address form (for example 'I wish to call your attention to…'). The book itself does not call them sermons. No text is stated. Opening words: “If some one had told me a few years ago that he thought Herod at one time came near the kingdom of God, I should have been inclined to doubt …” No text is announced. The opening paragraph quotes Mark vi, 20 as the verse that changed Moody's view of Herod. That is part of the argument, not an announced text.
